title: Quebec city & Montmorency Falls 1 Day Tour from Montreal
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Travelers easily reserve attraction/excursion tickets with the tour guide on the bus. If guests request ticket purchases and later change their mind after payment, we cannot be responsible for any refund. Once the purchase is made, the transaction is considered final, and no refunds will be issued.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: You will visit the only fortified city in North America with cobblestone walkways and well-preserved 17th-century architecture, all of which have given the entire city status as a UNESCO World Heritage Site such as Chateau Frontenac, the charming Place Royale, the Petit Champlain, and much more. Not only will you experience the old European charm but wonder at nature’s beauty while taking in the grander of Montmorency Falls, a full 30 m higher than Niagara Falls. In the winter, you can visit the Ice Hotel the only one of its kind in North America.
